cd /workspace; python3 - <<'EOF'
import sqlite3
src=sqlite3.connect('data/portal.sqlite')
dst=sqlite3.connect('out/backup.sqlite')
with dst:
    src.backup(dst)
src.close(); dst.close()
chk=sqlite3.connect('out/backup.sqlite')
print('integrity', chk.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
print('tables', [r[0] for r in chk.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' order by name")])
for t in ('events','bookings','series','overrides'):
    print(t, chk.execute(f'select count(*) from {t}').fetchone()[0])
print('overrides', chk.execute('select uid,source,utc,channels from overrides order by uid').fetchall())
print('series', chk.execute('select code,channels from series order by code').fetchall())
EOF
ls -l out/backup.sqlite data/portal.sqlite

cd /workspace; python3 project/prepare.py A 2026-04-01 2026-06-30 out/pilot-20260401-20260630-A.ics; python3 project/prepare.py B 2026-04-01 2026-06-30 out/pilot-20260401-20260630-B.ics; python3 project/prepare.py A 2026-04-01 2026-06-30 out/new-A.ics; echo ---; cmp out/pilot-20260401-20260630-A.ics out/new-A.ics && echo "new-A == A full"; cmp out/pilot-20260401-20260630-A.ics out/pilot-20260401-20260630-B.ics && echo "A == B"; python3 - <<'EOF'
for f in ('out/pilot-20260401-20260630-A.ics','out/pilot-20260401-20260630-B.ics','out/new-A.ics'):
    lines=open(f,'rb').read().decode().split('\r\n')
    uids=[l[4:] for l in lines if l.startswith('UID:')]
    dts=[l[8:] for l in lines if l.startswith('DTSTART:')]
    assert lines[0]=='BEGIN:VCALENDAR' and lines[-2]=='END:VCALENDAR'
    assert all(l=='STATUS:CONFIRMED' for l in lines if l.startswith('STATUS:'))
    print(f, 'events', len(uids), 'unique', len(set(uids)))
    print(' first', uids[:4], dts[:4])
    print(' last', uids[-2:], dts[-2:])
EOF
